[autotest] Change the Servo ssh verifier tag to 'servo_ssh' The verifier for ssh access to a Servo host or to a DUT was named 'ssh' for both. This created ambiguity for determining whether a given ssh failure was for the Servo host or the DUT. This is particularly a problem for automated parsing of logs, which need to make the distinction. This renames the Servo verifier to 'servo_ssh', so as to remove the ambiguity. BUG=None TEST=Run repair in a local instance.
